Unlock reliable influencer marketing - without the DMs.
BrandLink is the creator collaboration platform that helps brands find the right influencers and helps creators land paid brand deals. Search, compare, chat, and pay securely in one place to launch campaigns that actually convert.

For Brands
- Discover the right creators by niche, platform (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X), audience size, location, and budget.
- View packages & pricing up front (UGC, posts, stories, shorts/reels, whitelisting, more).
- Start campaigns fast with in-app chat, briefs, and simple booking.
- Pay securely and track deliverables in one workflow.
- Works great for startups, SMBs, e-commerce, and local brands.

For Influencers & UGC Creators
- Get discovered by brands that match your content and audience.
- Publish packages and set your rates (micro, nano, macro, mega).
- Earn from brand collaborations and manage everything in-app.
- Build long-term partnerships - not just one-off posts.

Why BrandLink
- Smart search & filters to match the right partners quickly.
- Transparent pricing and clear deliverables with package cards.
- Secure, in-app payments.
- Messaging & notifications to keep deals moving.
- Reviews & profiles that build trust on both sides.

Stop guessing which creators to work with and start running impactful, trackable campaigns.

Download BrandLink and launch your next collaboration today.

quotes.title: Help Me Help Startups Get Traction
quotes.story_title: Help Me Help Startups Get Traction

quotes.text:
When I launched my first startup, I was buzzing with excitement. I had an idea I believed in, a product I was proud of, and a vision of how it could change lives. But there was one thing I hadn’t accounted for: how impossible it felt to get noticed.

I tried everything—social media ads, cold outreach, even partnering with a small agency. The costs piled up, the results barely trickled in, and the dream of getting traction started to feel like a faraway goal. That’s when I began to notice something. The brands that were succeeding weren’t necessarily the ones with the best products—they were the ones that had the right people talking about them.

That realization changed everything. I started reaching out to influencers, but even that wasn’t easy. Agencies wanted a chunk of cash upfront, existing platforms were either too expensive or too complex, and getting influencers to respond directly was like shouting into the void. It felt like the whole system was designed for big brands, not startups or small businesses.

It was during one of these frustrating nights, staring at a failed ad campaign, that the idea for BrandLink hit me.

What if there was a way to make influencer marketing simple, affordable, and accessible for everyone—not just the businesses with million-dollar budgets? A platform where startups, small businesses, and even individuals with big ideas could connect directly with influencers, no middlemen, no ridiculous fees.
